facts.source_fact: Version 4 of the Low Carbon Hydrogen Standard was published in January 2026 and the landing page was updated on 5 February 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the Version 4 vintage to all downstream hydrogen-emissions calculations.

facts.source_fact: The LCHS provides a methodology for calculating lifecycle greenhouse-gas emissions from hydrogen production.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve lifecycle-method provenance rather than treating the output as a direct meter reading.

facts.source_fact: Hydrogen meeting the Standard must have greenhouse-gas emission intensity of 20 gCO2e/MJLHV or less.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the threshold unit and lower-heating-value basis with any compliance result.

facts.source_fact: Producers must calculate and report greenhouse-gas emissions up to the point of production using the prescribed methodology.
facts.expected_handling: Do not silently extend the boundary beyond the Standard's stated point of production.

facts.source_fact: Producers must employ an eligible hydrogen production pathway.
facts.expected_handling: Apply pathway eligibility before assessing low-carbon status.

facts.source_fact: The Standard requires a risk mitigation plan for fugitive hydrogen emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Record fugitive-emissions risk governance separately from lifecycle CO2e results.

facts.source_fact: The Standard requires an annual report on fugitive hydrogen emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Attach reporting-period metadata to fugitive-emissions evidence.

facts.source_fact: Additional requirements apply to the use of biogenic inputs depending on source and classification.
facts.expected_handling: Carry biogenic-source classification before applying emissions treatment.

facts.source_fact: Producers must meet Standard Compliance conditions applicable to their production pathway.
facts.expected_handling: Do not transfer compliance conditions between production pathways without an explicit mapping.

facts.source_fact: A Data Collection and Monitoring Procedure must be in place with the relevant Delivery Partner for the scheme applying the Standard.
facts.expected_handling: Require documented data and monitoring governance for scheme use.

facts.source_fact: Version 4 expands biomethane eligibility to allow sourcing through the gas grid under a mass-balance approach.
facts.expected_handling: Mark gas-grid mass-balance evidence explicitly rather than treating it as physical molecule tracing.

facts.source_fact: Version 4 simplifies the material-classification process for Refinery Off Gas.
facts.expected_handling: Use Version 4 classification rules for current records.

facts.source_fact: Version 4 introduces a new process for evidencing Renewable Energy Guarantees of Origin.
facts.expected_handling: Retain REGO evidence provenance with electricity-related emissions claims.

facts.source_fact: Version 4 adds asphalt as a permissible solid-carbon end use and clarifies gas-splitting pathway requirements.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the current end-use list and pathway-specific conditions.

facts.source_fact: Version 4 adds a section on stored feedstocks and fuels.
facts.expected_handling: Attach storage-related requirements where feedstocks or fuels are stored.

facts.source_fact: Version 4 updates emissions factors, technical parameters and calculation methodologies in the Data Annex.
facts.expected_handling: Version all factors and parameters used in calculations.

facts.source_fact: The Hydrogen Emissions Calculator was updated for use with Version 4.
facts.expected_handling: Use a calculator version consistent with the applicable Standard version.

facts.source_fact: Two calculator versions are provided: a streamlined electrolytic-project version and a full version covering current eligible pathways.
facts.expected_handling: Select the calculator according to the project's production pathway.

facts.source_fact: Electrolytic projects using biogenic inputs to generate electricity must use the full calculator version.
facts.expected_handling: Block use of the streamlined calculator for this case.

facts.source_fact: On 5 February 2026 the full Hydrogen Emissions Calculator was revised to correct a minor Dashboard formula error.
facts.expected_handling: Treat calculator build date as part of reproducibility evidence.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach pathway, lifecycle boundary and scheme applicability before downstream use.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing incompatible hydrogen pathways or boundaries.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach Standard and calculator version dates.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents stale factors or calculator logic being used.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry source URL, calculation basis, factor vintage and calculator provenance.
Do not convert hydrogen-production lifecycle data into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.
